label: Neubrutalist
aesthetic: Bold, raw, unapologetic. Thick borders, offset shadows, primary colors clashing with purpose. Maximum contrast, zero pretense. For brands that want to stand out, not blend in.
sectionSuggestionsNote: Neubrutalism works best with simple, direct layouts. Avoid heavy gradients and glass effects. Prefer solid colors, thick borders, and offset shadows. Keep animations minimal and snappy.
